verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sentry ingests OpenTelemetry traces and logs and offers a Trace Explorer for span samples. Nothing documents navigating from a span to its correlated logs or metrics. Ingesting both signals and exploring spans on their own are adjacent capabilities, not the span-to-logs/metrics correlation this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end
